source: Gutach: Noch mehr Sicherheit für Fußgänger
hypothesis: Gutach: Even more security for pedestrians

source: Sie stehen keine 100 Meter voneinander entfernt: Am Dienstag ist in Gutach die neue B 33-Fußgängerampel am Dorfparkplatz in Betrieb genommen worden - in Sichtweite der älteren Rathausampel.
reference: They are not even 100 metres apart: On Tuesday, the new B 33 pedestrian lights in Dorfparkplatz in Gutach became operational - within view of the existing Town Hall traffic lights.
hypothesis: They are not 100 metres apart: On Tuesday, in Gutach , the new B 33 pedestrian traffic light on the village square is in operation. In sight of the older traffic light in front of the town hall.

source: Zwei Anlagen so nah beieinander: Absicht oder Schildbürgerstreich?
reference: Two sets of lights so close to one another: intentional or just a silly error?
hypothesis: Two plants so close together: intentional or coincidence?

source: Diese Frage hat Gutachs Bürgermeister gestern klar beantwortet.
reference: Yesterday, Gutacht's Mayor gave a clear answer to this question.
hypothesis: This question has been answered by Gutach Mayor yesterday.

source: "Die Rathausampel ist damals installiert worden, weil diese den Schulweg sichert", erläuterte Eckert gestern.
reference: "At the time, the Town Hall traffic lights were installed because this was a school route," explained Eckert yesterday.
hypothesis: "The town hall traffic light was installed because the school route was secured," explained Eckert.

source: Die Kluser-Ampel sichere sowohl Radfahrer als auch Busfahrgäste und die Bergle-Bewohner.
reference: The Kluser lights protect cyclists, as well as those travelling by bus and the residents of Bergle.
hypothesis: The Kluser traffic lights ensure safety for both cyclists and pedestrians.

source: Die gestern offiziell in Betrieb genommene Anlage sei wichtig für den Kreuzungsbereich Sulzbachweg/Kirchstraße.
reference: The system, which officially became operational yesterday, is of importance to the Sulzbachweg/Kirchstrasse junction.
hypothesis: The plant, which was officially put into operation yesterday, is important for the Sulzbachweg/Kirchstraße junction.

source: Wir haben das Museum, zwei Kirchen, Kurpark, die Bushaltestelle, einen Arzt und eine Bank sowie den Verkehrsfluss aus dem Wohngebiet ›Grub‹.
reference: We have the museum, two churches, the spa gardens, the bus stop, a doctor's practice and a bank, not to mention the traffic from the 'Grub' residential area.
hypothesis: We have the museum, two churches, a spa park, the bus stop, the doctor, the bank. We have a flow of traffic from the residential area.

source: "Bei dem hohen Verkehrs- und Fußgängeraufkommen musste zu deren Sicherheit eine weitere Ampel her", so Eckert.
reference: "At times of high road and pedestrian traffic, an additional set of lights were required to ensure safety," said Eckert.
hypothesis: "With the high traffic and pedestrian volume, a further set of traffic lights had to be installed for their safety," said Eckert.

source: Dies bestätigt auch Peter Arnold vom Landratsamt Offenburg.
reference: This was also confirmed by Peter Arnold from the Offenburg District Office.
hypothesis: This also confirms Peter Arnold from the district office of Offenburg.

source: "Laut aktuellen Messungen durchfahren auf der B 33 täglich etwa 12 000 Fahrzeuge die Gemeinde Gutach, davon sind etwa zehn Prozent Schwerlastverkehr", betont Arnold.
reference: "According to current measurements, around 12,000 vehicles travel through the town of Gutach on the B33 on a daily basis, of which heavy goods traffic accounts for around ten per cent," emphasised Arnold.
hypothesis: "According to current measurements, the B 33 is used by around 12,000 vehicles every day." said Arnold, "of which around ten percent are heavy goods vehicles."

source: Daher sei der Bau einer weiteren Ampel mehr als notwendig: "Sicherheit geht hier einfach vor", so Arnold.
reference: Therefore the construction of an additional set of lights was more than necessary: "Here safety comes first, it's that simple," said Arnold.
hypothesis: Therefore, the construction of a further traffic light is more than necessary. "Safety comes before everything," said Arnold.
